result.topic_en: A grid table of primes (rows 3 to 181, columns 97 to 223), page 2, in which small circles mark prime pairs with a quadratic-residue relation and connecting lines join related entries.

methods.what: Tabulation of a pairwise relation, presumably quadratic residuacity, between odd primes. Rows run over primes 3–181 and columns over primes 97–223. A circle marks a pair where the relation holds, and connecting lines join marked pairs.
methods.quote: [grid of small circles at row/column intersections, joined by horizontal and vertical line segments; no other text]
